stem.en: Sort each startup idea into its field.

text.en: Paying a vegetable seller by scanning a code with a phone
A sensor that tells a farmer when the field needs water
A video call with a doctor for a patient in a village
Sending money to a friend from a phone

explanation.en: Paying a seller and sending money from a phone are digital payments, so they are fin-tech. A sensor that helps a farmer is farming technology, agri-tech. A video call with a doctor is online healthcare, health-tech.

hints.en: Ask what each idea helps with: money, farming or health.
